thread:
Anya: quick sync — planning to add `tokens_consumed` (int) to /v1/generate response. question: do we treat this as additive non-breaking or do we need a new version? looking for ops + SDK impact.

Dmitri: if clients do strict JSON schema validation some will break. Are we guaranteed to never remove fields?

Anya: it would be additive only. but some clients use exact-match checks. want guidance on rollout window and whether we should gate by header negotiation.

Maria: +1 about header negotiation. we could support an `Accept-Response-Version: 1` header and default to the new shape when absent. or surface via `/v2/generate`. tradeoff: more routes vs more headers.

Kevin: leaning header-based canary. we can have `X-Redwood-Response-Version: 1.1` for the new shape. canary users opt-in. also need SDK bumps to deserialize optional field safely. who owns SDK updates?

Anya: proposing 6-week deprecation window (announce -> canary -> wide rollout). enterprise customers get extra 2w. infra: need automated contract tests + canary gating. Sam, can eng-platform run the schema/contract CI against canary?

Sam: we currently have `api-contract-check` job that validates openapi schema diffs on PRs, but it doesn't run integration clients. we can add a contract-e2e job that runs a handful of real SDKs against the canary endpoint. timeline: ~3 days to add. also we can add a console flag to route specific orgs to canary.

Dmitri: example client test (curl) below — includes header negotiation + fallback logic:

```bash
# request new shape if supported, otherwise fall back
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Response-Version: 1.1" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
     -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

# client should handle missing `tokens_consumed` gracefully (default null/0)
```

Maria: we should also define monitoring:
- 4xx/5xx spike for SDKs
- `schema_validation_errors` metric from the SDKs
- rate of requests that fall back to legacy behavior (if we implement)
- user-facing error rates in the console

Sam: I'll add canary routing and wire up metrics. can we get a short PR that updates the OpenAPI with `tokens_consumed` as `nullable: true` so our current schema diff shows additive change? that will help.

Anya: yep i'll open the API spec PR today and add a short migration note. also need a tiny docs snippet: how to opt-in via `X-Redwood-Response-Version` and how to handle missing field.

Kevin: i can do SDK patches for python/js clients — will ensure deserialization tolerates absent field and add unit tests.

Dmitri: what about customer comms? do we email everyone or only those actively using the endpoint?

Maria: email + console banner for orgs that hit the endpoint frequently. add an in-product deprecation banner 4 weeks before wide rollout.

Anya: consensus: additive -> single-header opt-in canary -> 6 week window (8 for enterprise) -> contract-e2e + canary metrics. Sam will own infra changes; Kevin owns SDKs; i'll own API PR + docs + comms. i'll open a tracking ticket and tag you all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary route toggled for orgs: redwood-internal, beta-partners at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z (scheduled).

Sam: noted — i'll add the `contract-e2e` job and the canary dashboard this week. please link the API spec PR here when ready.

Anya: thanks everyone, i'll post the ticket and migration checklist shortly.
